question: A district has 10,24,000 inhabitants. If the population increases at the rate 2.5% per annum, find the number of inhabitants at the end of three years.
solution:
Given:

A district has 10,24,000 inhabitants. 

The population increases at the rate of 2.5% per annum.

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P
